items.title: 87% of the Anthropic power will come from gas and 11% from coal in 2028
items.summary: An analysis of Anthropic's power commitments indicates that the company will rely heavily on fossil fuels, with gas and coal expected to make up the vast majority of its power sources by 2028. The report highlights that data center energy demands are increasingly leading companies to secure dedicated power generation and driving new fossil infrastructure on the grid.
items.why_it_matters: It highlights the significant fossil fuel energy demands and infrastructure buildout driven by rapidly scaling AI data centers.

items.title: A Beginner's Guide to Local AI with Inkling, Qwen, and Unsloth
items.summary: A beginner's guide explains how to set up and run local AI models on consumer Windows hardware using tools like Unsloth Desktop and open-weight models like Qwen. This allows users to bypass cloud usage limits, costs, and privacy concerns by hosting their own private chatbot infrastructure at home.
items.why_it_matters: It provides a practical walkthrough for individuals wanting to run private, capable AI models locally without relying on cloud providers.

items.title: Show HN: I built a game where you are an LLM's subagent
items.summary: A developer has built a browser-based game where the player acts as a subagent to an AI manager, carrying out terminal tasks assigned by models like Claude, GPT, or Gemini. The AI manager issues instructions, reviews work, and writes performance reviews while interacting with the user's sandbox or environment.
items.why_it_matters: It offers a playful yet functional demonstration of orchestrator-subagent workflows using real LLMs.

items.title: EL4CTEO/fast-anything: Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the 5% that's slow: profile Python, Node or Ruby apps, port the hot functions with
items.summary: A tool called fast-anything profiles Python, Node, Ruby, and other apps to find slow functions, then uses coding agents to port only those bottleneck functions into Rust. It verifies correctness against real recorded calls and edge cases before safely swapping the optimized code into the application.
items.why_it_matters: It automates the process of accelerating software performance using AI coding agents without requiring a full application rewrite.

items.title: Data Processing Incidents on Inference Providers
items.summary: Following security reports about compromised data and broken privacy policies at certain third-party AI inference providers, OpenRouter has removed several providers and endpoints from its Zero Data Retention eligibility. They have also notified affected customers and are implementing ongoing testing techniques to verify network paths and enforce stricter data policies.
items.why_it_matters: This highlights ongoing security and privacy vulnerabilities among third-party AI inference providers and shows how platform operators are stepping up enforcement.

items.title: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
items.summary: Researchers explore a mixing trade-off in manifold-constrained hyper-connections, identifying issues when residual matrices are either under-mixed or over-mixed. To fix this, they propose Contraction for Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (cmHC), a method that geometrically contracts the Birkhoff polytope toward its interior to enable stable gradient propagation during large-scale model pretraining. They also developed fused operators for Ascend NPUs that reduce execution latency by up to 44.8%.
items.why_it_matters: This method improves gradient stability and lowers execution latency during the pretraining of large dense and mixture-of-experts models.

items.title: erkamyaman/safe-anything: Find the holes before someone else does. A fast, 100% Rust vulnerability scanner: XSS, SQL injection, leaked secre
items.summary: Safe-anything is a fast, Rust-based vulnerability scanner designed to detect security issues like XSS, SQL injection, leaked secrets, vulnerable dependencies, and insecure AI agent setups. It requires no configuration or account and provides the exact line, reason, and fix for each vulnerability found.
items.why_it_matters: It gives developers a local tool to automatically scan codebases and AI agent configurations for critical security flaws before deployment.

items.title: Non-penetrating World Models
items.summary: Researchers introduce NoPeBench to evaluate how interactive video world models handle physical obstacles, finding that current open-source models fail to reliably prevent object penetration. To fix this, they developed NoPeWorld, a lightweight framework that trains a small prediction head on top of a frozen diffusion transformer's hidden states to filter out unsafe actions.
items.why_it_matters: The approach substantially reduces physical violation rates in video world models without needing extensive retraining.

items.title: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview Technical Report
items.summary: The technical report introduces Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with 35 billion total parameters and 3 billion activated parameters that supports thinking-mode generation. It uses Gated Delta Networks and achieves strong performance on agent benchmarks while delivering high token generation speeds on a single GPU.
items.why_it_matters: It showcases a new mixture-of-experts diffusion model architecture optimized for agent workloads and fast inference generation speeds.

items.title: w01fb0ss/PiBot: Open-source, local-first AI agent team for your desktop: multi-agent group chats, computer use, browser, MCP, routines and a
items.summary: Pi Bot is an open-source, local-first desktop application that runs a team of AI agents capable of planning, running commands, editing files, and browsing the web. It operates locally on macOS, Windows, Linux, and Android, keeping user data private while requiring approval for risky actions.
items.why_it_matters: It provides a desktop-based, privacy-focused tool for coordinating multiple AI agents to perform complex computer tasks.

items.title: Supercharging transformer residual connections
items.summary: Google Research introduced DeepCrossAttention (DCA), an architecture that enhances transformer residual connections by using learnable weights and cross-attention. This allows models to dynamically combine outputs from previous layers, avoiding information dilution and reaching the same quality up to three times faster.
items.why_it_matters: It offers a way to train deep transformer networks faster and more efficiently without major parameter increases.

items.title: RoboTrack: Point tracking for real-world robotic manipulation
items.summary: Researchers introduced RoboTrack, a benchmark and training data suite designed to improve point tracking for real-world robotic manipulation. The suite includes RoboTrack-Bench, which contains human-annotated real-world videos, and RoboTrack-15M, a synthetic dataset generated via simulation to help robots better track grippers and objects.
items.why_it_matters: It helps bridge the gap between simulation and real-world robotics by providing better data and benchmarks for tracking objects during manipulation.

items.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
items.summary: Google DeepMind used teams of Gemini agents alongside a formal theorem prover called Lean to find faster, highly efficient quantum algorithms. The agent teams collaboratively optimized quantum circuits for applications like fusion energy and drug design, drastically reducing required computing costs and memory.
items.why_it_matters: It demonstrates how AI agent teams combined with formal verification can solve complex scientific optimization problems.

items.title: Learning Video Foresight Reasoning from Unlabeled Videos via On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.summary: Researchers introduced Future-OPSD, an on-policy self-distillation framework that helps vision-language models learn video foresight reasoning from unlabeled videos without external annotations. The method uses a foresight score and a contrastive advantage to focus the model on decision-relevant future information while ignoring irrelevant context.
items.why_it_matters: It improves how vision-language models anticipate future events in videos without relying on costly manual annotations or large external models.
